description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. Electric arrow ability emblem. A BIG bright yellow ZIGZAG LIGHTNING BOLT with three angular bends is the dominant shape, pointing diagonally up-right and ending with an arrowhead. Small brown arrow fletching at the bottom. Lightning silhouette is essential. Blue electric accent behind the yellow zigzag. Not a straight spear or ordinary arrow.
